quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, alright then. I'll ask somebody else. I don't get it... Why is everybody ordering take-out lately?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Just remember <color=#00E1FFFF>not to get hit or run too fast</color>. I don't think Wallit will accept Tea Break Pancakes that look all messed up.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Why isn't it here yet? I have things to do, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Oh, it's finally here, is it? Give it here — I have things to do and places to be.

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: I've heard that you can find suitable brewing ingredients around these parts...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That's right. Great timing, Traveler! Wallit ordered a stack of Tea Break Pancakes from us earlier. Don't worry, he's already paid beforehand.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: He wants us to bring it to a place south of Brightcrown Canyon...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But we've been getting more and more take-out orders lately for some reason, and we can barely keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you help us with this delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Why isn't it here yet? I have things to do, you know!
